app.notes:
Crowd Score: after each song, guests vote 1 to 5 stars on their phones. Turn it on in Settings, Scoring, Score Mode
Reactions: hearts, laughs, fire, claps and Encore from guests' phones float up the side of the stage
Dedications: reserve a song for someone, like "For Lola", and it shows on the song's title card
The Lobby: between songs the stage shows who's up next, who it's for, the QR code to join, and tonight's top scores
Host Lock and Rental: Settings behind a PIN, and paid time or songs that lock the stage when they run out
A new dark glass control panel on the stage, in your theme's colours
The Pitch Guide works without a microphone now: the melody's notes fly into a glowing line and spark as they hit. Turn it on or off in Settings, Lyrics & Countdown
Real applause, cheers and a party horn, and drum sounds played on the SoundFont, instead of made-up sounds
